title: The words for four receipt refusals from the server are never tested
what: The server refuses a receipt over what is owed, a receipt number already used, a date in the future and a change to a saved receipt, and those refusals are tested. The admin app turns each refusal into words for the owner, but no test checks those words. Only the owner-only, PIN and plan refusals have word tests.
expected: A test that feeds each of these server refusals to the admin app and checks the exact sentence the owner reads.
fix_line: Add a word test for each receipt refusal the server can send

title: The receipt history the server keeps is never shown to the owner
what: The server writes a history line each time a receipt is cancelled, removed by an undo or changed in the database, and lets only the owner read it. Nothing in the admin app, the HQ app or the member app ever asks for it, so the owner cannot see who changed a receipt. The journeys expect the owner to read it on a screen.
expected: An owner screen that shows each receipt change with when, who and the old and new values, with a test; or the journeys changed to say the history is server-only.
how_often: whenever an owner checks a changed receipt
fix_line: Show the receipt history to the owner, or say in the journeys it is kept only on the server

title: The server's checks on branding and product photos are never tested
what: The database tests only check that the front desk is refused and the owner allowed on the branding and product photo calls, and that an upload under a made-up ticket is refused. No test sends a colour that is not a colour code, a logo or photo link from outside our store, a photo for a product deleted meanwhile, or the upload past the limit that answers busy. The panel's logo rule is checked only by reading the server change's text.
expected: Database tests that send each bad value to the branding and product photo calls and check the refusal and that nothing was saved.
fix_line: Add database tests for bad colours, outside links, a deleted product and the upload limit

title: Joining a gym with a wrong code, no name or when busy is never tested on the server
what: The join tests only send a good code and a good name. No database test sends a wrong code, an empty name or enough joins to get the busy answer. On the phone the empty-name and busy answers are read, but the words a member sees for them are never checked.
expected: A database test for each join refusal, and phone word tests for the empty-name and busy answers.
fix_line: Test the three join refusals on the server and their words on the phone

title: No database test reads the list of members who joined in the app
what: The call that lists a gym's app members, with their phone numbers and shop money, is only named in the list of calls the app may make. No database test reads it, so nothing checks that members who left are gone from it, that the number shown is the one they gave, or that the front desk gets the same list.
expected: A database test that reads the list as owner and front desk, with one member who left, and checks who is on it and what it shows.
fix_line: Add a database test that reads the app members list, with a left member

title: Some My membership card words are never tested
what: The titles 'Your number is shared' and 'Your gym has a different number' are never checked; only one word of the line under them is. The 'has no plan for you on record. Ask the desk.' line, a current plan shown with the next one after it, and that days left never go below zero are not checked either.
expected: Word tests for each card title and line in these states.
how_often: whenever the card is in one of these states
fix_line: Add exact-word checks for the shared-number, different-number and no-plan cards

title: Taking back a workout plan is never tested as a trainer
what: The test hides a sent plan from members by changing the record straight in the database. No test sends the take-back from a trainer's or owner's sign-in, so nothing checks the server accepts it from them and keeps who made the plan.
expected: A database test where the trainer's sign-in takes the plan back and the member's list then has no plan.
fix_line: Take the plan back through the trainer's sign-in in the test

title: Cancelling a membership as the owner and marking a session on a cancelled pack are never tried
what: The owner tests cancel a receipt, take back a session, sell back-dated and give extra days, but never cancel a membership. The front desk tests never mark a personal training session on a pack that was cancelled.
expected: Database tests for the owner cancelling a membership and the desk marking a session on a cancelled pack.
fix_line: Add the two missing cases to the staff and owner rules test

title: Importing again after an undo, and undoing one of two imports, are never tested
what: The undo test has one import only. No test undoes one import while an earlier good import stays, and no test imports the same file again after an undo to check each member, plan and payment comes back once and payments are not counted twice. The half-import message tells owners to do exactly this.
expected: A test with two imports where one is undone and the other stays, then the same file imported again with each record once.
fix_line: Add a two-import undo test and a re-import after undo

title: Check-in refusals never check that nothing was written
what: When a member scans another gym's poster, the test checks only the refusal; it never checks that no visit was written in either gym and that no names came back. A second scan while the desk has not yet answered a typed number is never tried.
expected: The test counts visits after the other-gym scan and reads the answer for names, and scans again while the request waits.
fix_line: Count visits and read the answer after each refused check-in
